description: 后翼兵型 D30 — 预判c线，Rc1提前占位

intro.popup_en: Line Control, Lesson 2: Anticipate which file will open and place a rook there early. White's Rc1 arrives before the c-file opens.
intro.popup:
线路控制第2课
预判线路，提前布车
本局核心：Rc1
在c线打开前就占位！

outro.popup_en: The anticipation pays off: Rc1 is already in place before the c-file opens. After ...bxc5, Black's pawn is exposed to the rook. Predicting the file lets you control it as soon as it opens.
outro.popup:
预判原则成功实现！
Rc1在c线打开前就已就位
bxc5之后c5兵直接暴露在车下
这就是预判线路的价值！

moves.popup_en: d4 occupies the center and controls e5 and c5, beginning a Queen's Pawn opening.
moves.popup:
d4占中心
控制e5、c5
后翼开局开始

moves.popup_en: ...d5 mirrors White's central occupation. The pawns face each other and the center is closed for now.
moves.popup:
黑方d5对称
双方兵对峙
封闭中心格局

moves.popup_en: c4! The Queen's Gambit challenges d5. The c-file may become the main battleground.
moves.popup:
c4！后翼弃兵
白方c4挑战d5
c线即将成为战场

moves.popup_en: ...e6 supports d5 in a solid Queen's Gambit Declined setup. Black does not accept the gambit yet.
moves.popup:
黑方e6保护d5
稳健的后翼防御
暂时不接受兑换

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops, supports c4, and helps White contest the center.
moves.popup:
Nc3发展马
支持c4，准备反压
白方建立中心优势

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and remains flexible, ready to respond to White's central setup.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展马
攻击e4（如果白方走）
黑方灵活应对

moves.popup_en: Bg5 pressures the knight on f6. If Black does not respond, White may exchange it with Bxf6, changing the position and increasing the c-file tension.
moves.popup:
Bg5象施压f6马
如果黑方不处理
白方可Bxf6后局面变化
c线争夺加剧

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 responds calmly, keeps the knight on f6, and prepares to castle.
moves.popup:
Be7稳健应对
黑方保持f6马
准备王车易位

moves.popup_en: e3 reinforces the center and supports steady development.
moves.popup:
e3巩固中心
白方稳健发展
准备完成开局

moves.popup_en: Black castles to secure the king. The sequence ...h6, Bh4, and ...b6 is coming.
moves.popup:
黑方王车易位
王躲安全
注意：h6-Bh4-b6序列即将到来

moves.popup_en: Nf3 completes White's minor-piece development. White must now resolve the tension between c4 and d5.
moves.popup:
Nf3发展马
白方轻子全部出动
现在需要处理c4-d5的紧张局面

moves.popup_en: ...h6 challenges the bishop because Black does not want to allow Bxf6 to remove the f6-knight.
moves.popup:
h6追象
黑方不想让Bg5换掉f6马
白方象被迫撤退

moves.popup_en: Bh4 retreats while keeping the bishop and its pressure on Nf6.
moves.popup:
Bh4撤退
白方保留象，等待时机
继续盯住f6马

moves.popup_en: ...b6 prepares ...Bb7, developing the bishop and completing Black's queenside setup.
moves.popup:
b6准备Bb7
黑方发展黑格象到b7
后翼防御体系成型

moves.popup_en: cxd5! White exchanges and opens the c-file. The file is now semi-open; where should the rook go?
moves.popup:
cxd5！c线开始打开
白方兑换后c线半开放
现在车应该去哪？

moves.popup_en: ...exd5 recaptures and leaves a strong pawn on d5. The c-file is now semi-open.
moves.popup:
exd5黑方重提
d5有力兵
c线正式半开放

moves.popup_en: Bd3! The bishop takes an active position and targets h7, giving White attacking chances.
moves.popup:
Bd3！象占主动位
瞄准h7方向
白方进攻态势初显

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7 develops the dark-squared bishop and controls the long diagonal toward g2. Black's queenside setup is nearly complete.
moves.popup:
Bb7黑格象出动
控制g2-b7斜线
黑方后翼防御基本完成

moves.popup_en: White castles and completes the opening development. The next question is how to use the c-file.
moves.popup:
白方王车易位
开局发展完毕
下一步：如何利用c线？

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops and prepares the ...c5 counterbreak, completing Black's setup.
moves.popup:
Nbd7发展马
黑方准备c5反击
黑方阵形趋于完整

moves.popup_en: Rc1! White anticipates the file opening. The c-file is only semi-open, but White expects ...c5 to open it fully and places the rook there in advance.
moves.popup:
Rc1！预判布车
此时c线还是半开放
但白方已经预见——
黑方必推c5，届时c线全开！
Rc1提前就位，占领先机

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black counterattacks in the center as White predicted. The c-file is about to open, and Rc1 is already in place.
moves.popup:
c5！黑方反击中心
正如白方预料！
现在Rc1的价值显现：
c线即将完全开放

moves.popup_en: dxc5 opens the c-file completely. White's rook on c1 controls the file and puts pressure on Black's pawn.
moves.popup:
dxc5白方兑换
c线完全开放！
Rc1直接控制c线
黑方的c5兵受到压力

moves.popup_en: ...bxc5 recaptures, but the pawn on c5 is exposed to the rook on c1. White's prediction was correct: anticipate the file, place the rook, and control it as soon as it opens.
moves.popup:
bxc5黑方重提
c5兵暴露在c1车的攻击下
Rc1的预判完全正确！
预判线路→提前布车→线开即控
